rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Refraction.** Light bends while crossing obliquely between media of different optical density because its speed changes; it bends towards the normal entering a denser medium and away from it leaving.  ·  **Snell's law.** For a ray crossing the boundary, n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r, with the incident ray, refracted ray and normal all in one plane and sin i/sin r constant for the pair of media.  ·  **Refractive index.** The absolute index of a medium is n = c/v; the relative index of medium 2 w.r.t. 1 is n₂₁ = v₁/v₂ = sin i/sin r = 1/n₁₂.
